Lalit Kumar ………Petitioner
Vs.
B.H.E.L. and others ………Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Anoop Kumar Jaiswal, learned counsel has 
instructions to appear on behalf of the respondents.
3. It is case of the petitioner that the petitioner was 
appointed with the respondents-B.H.E.L. at Haridwar on the 
post of Supervisor in the year 2016 and thereafter was 
promoted on the post of Engineer in the year 2020.
4. It is case of the petitioner that his juniors have been 
promoted from E1 to E2 while he has not been promoted for 
no reason, despite recommendation made by the 
Departmental Promotion Committee in the year 2024.
5. Learned counsel for the respondents prays for and is 
granted four weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
6. List this case on 13.10.2026.
7. Office is directed to show the name of Mr. Anoop 
Kumar Jaiswal, learned counsel for the respondents, 
henceforth in the cause list. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.09.2026
SK
